# Support

The official repository is [supay8/go-siat](https://github.com/supay8/go-siat).

For bug reports and technical questions, use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/supay8/go-siat/issues).
Include the SDK version, SIAT version, sector, expected behavior and a minimal reproduction.
Remove tokens, taxpayer data and signing credentials from examples and logs.

Original authorship and license notices remain in the repository history and LICENSE.
